sections.changelog:
Fixed

  • **Mobile search bar no longer breaks on narrow screens.** With a plain search bar, the live results now stay readable on phones in both modes: with full-screen search on, the input field stays pinned at the top above the results instead of being hidden behind the overlay; with it off, the inline dropdown drops the desktop-only side preview so the results list keeps the full width instead of being squeezed into a sliver. The icon and text-link trigger modes are unchanged.
